name: @wizeworks/cache-revalidation-worker
description: sparx cache-revalidation handler, run by services/event-worker. Consumes catalog, content, site-publish and site-settings events, resolves the event's tenant to its slug, and POSTs the site's /api/revalidate route so the cached reads a visitor sees (products, pages, the business payload with its name, logo, socials, cookie banner and billing phase) are purged the moment the owner saves, instead of waiting out the cache.
